DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 資料のグラフで、分からない所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything in the graph in the material that you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。線の横に百とありますが、これは百円という意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 投資信託資料グラフの百という数字の単位を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There is a hundred beside the line. Does that mean a hundred yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what unit the number one hundred in the investment fund graph represents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この資料では、開始日の値を百とした比較用の数字です。金額そのものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this material it is a number for comparison, with the value on the starting date set at one hundred. It is not the monetary amount itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開始日を百としているのですね。実線と点線は、それぞれ何を表していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 基準値を理解し実線点線の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the starting date is set at one hundred. What do the solid and dotted lines each represent?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand the base value and ask what the solid and dotted lines mean. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実線はこの商品の値動き、点線は比較対象の指数です。下の凡例にもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The solid line is this product's price movement, and the dotted line is the index it is compared with. They are also in the legend below.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 凡例が読めました。実線が九十の月は、開始日より一割下がったと読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 凡例と九十の開始日比一割低下の解釈を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can read the legend now. In a month where the solid line is at ninety, can I read that as a ten percent decrease from the starting date?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the legend and your interpretation that ninety means ten percent below the starting value. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その読み方です。開始日からの比較で、前の月からの変化とは異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is correct. It is a comparison with the starting date, which is different from the change from the previous month.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中で下がった月も分かりました。最後が百を超えていても、これから上がると決まったわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 低下月を読み過去実績と今後の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can also see the months when it fell along the way. Even if it finishes above one hundred, that does not mean it is certain to rise from now on, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the months of decline and check the difference between past performance and the future. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 過去の値動きで、今後の結果を保証するものではありません。費用やリスクの説明もこの後にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: These are past price movements and do not guarantee future results. There is also an explanation of costs and risks later in the material.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: グラフの数字と二本の線の意味が分かりました。資料を持ち帰り、費用とリスクの欄も読んでから質問をまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数字線の意味を理解し費用リスク欄を読んで質問を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand the graph's numbers and the meaning of the two lines now. I will take the material home, read the costs and risks section as well, and then organize my questions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you understand the numbers and lines and will read the costs and risks section to organize your questions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお持ちください。またご不明な点をお尋ねください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take it with you. Do ask again if anything is unclear. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷凍食品をお買い求めですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家まで歩いて二十分です。保冷袋を持っていないので、ここで買える袋を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 徒歩二十分の持帰り用保冷袋を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a twenty-minute walk home. I have no insulated bag, so I would like to see the bags I can buy here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for an insulated bag to carry food home on a twenty-minute walk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大小二種類あります。今のかごの品でしたら、大きい方に入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have two sizes, large and small. The items in your basket will fit in the large one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この三袋をまとめたいです。大きい袋は持ち手がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三袋用の大きい袋の持ち手を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to put these three packets together. Does the large bag have handles?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about handles on the large bag for the three packets. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: あります。口も閉められます。保冷剤はこちらで別に販売しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The opening also closes. Ice packs are sold separately here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋と保冷剤を一つずつ買います。保冷剤はもう冷えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋と保冷剤の購入と冷却状態を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will buy one bag and one ice pack. Is the ice pack already cold?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will buy a bag and an ice pack and ask whether it is cold already. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは凍った物です。袋と一緒に会計へお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This one is frozen. I will take it to the checkout together with the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。冷凍食品は会計の最後までかごに入れておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計まで冷凍食品をかごに置くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you, that helps. I will leave the frozen food in the basket until the checkout is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the frozen food in the basket until checkout. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計が終わりました。袋詰め台で一緒に入れて口を閉めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Checkout is complete. Please put them together at the bagging counter and close the opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三袋と保冷剤が入りました。口を閉めたので、途中で寄り道せず帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 詰めた品と口を確認し直帰すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The three packets and the ice pack are in. I have closed it, so I will go straight home without stopping elsewhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the packed items and the closed opening and say you will go straight home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お買い上げありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for shopping with us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写生をされるのですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。絵の具を広げる小さな机がある場所を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写生用に絵の具を広げる机を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am looking for a place with a small table to spread out my paints.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for a table to spread out paints for sketching. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 東屋に机があります。今日は空いていますが、椅子は固定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a table in the gazebo. It is free today, but the seats are fixed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 立って描くことが多いので、固定の椅子でも大丈夫です。水道は近くにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 固定椅子を了承し水道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I often paint standing up, so fixed seats are fine. Is there a water tap nearby?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept the fixed seats and ask about a tap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飲み水の水道はありますが、絵の具の筆を洗う場所ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a drinking-water tap, but it is not a place to wash paintbrushes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 筆洗い用の水は持参しました。使った水を戻せる容器もあるので、それを使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参の筆洗い水と回収容器を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought water for washing my brushes. I also have a container to collect the used water, so I will use that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought brush-washing water and a container to collect it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでしたら、机を汚さない敷物もご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: In that case, please also prepare something to cover the table so it does not get dirty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この防水のシートを敷きます。花壇が見える側を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 敷物を示し花壇が見える側を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will lay down this waterproof sheet. I would like to use the side facing the flowerbeds.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the protective sheet and ask for the side with a view of the flowerbeds. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そちらから見えます。作業を終えたら敷物を片付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can see them from that side. Please put away the sheet when you have finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 机の場所が分かりました。描き終えた水と敷物は持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 机位置を確認し水と敷物の持帰りを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I know where the table is now. I will take the water left after painting and the sheet home with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the table's location and say you will take the water and sheet home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ写生をお楽しみください。それでは、失礼します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの自転車についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the bicycle you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 折り畳み自転車を列車に載せたいです。袋に入れる前に、持込みの条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 折畳自転車の持込み条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take my folding bicycle on the train. Before putting it in the bag, I would like to ask about the conditions for bringing it aboard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the conditions for taking a folding bicycle aboard. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 折り畳んだ状態で全体を収納する袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a bag that contains the whole bicycle when folded?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、この袋です。車輪まで入れられますが、肩掛けのベルトだけ外に出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車輪収納袋とベルトの状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this bag. Even the wheels fit inside, but only the shoulder strap sticks out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the bag that holds the wheels and the state of the strap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ベルトは運ぶために使えます。大きさなども確認しますので、畳んだ状態にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The strap can be used to carry it. We will check its size and other details too, so please fold it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで畳みます。通路を空けて作業できる場所はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 折畳作業できる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will fold it here. Where can I do that without blocking the passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where you can fold the bicycle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 壁際の空いた所でお願いします。お手伝いは必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use the empty area beside the wall. Do you need any help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 畳めました。自分で持てる重さです。車輪も全部入ったので見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 畳んで全体収納と運搬能力を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have folded it. It is a weight I can carry myself. The wheels are all inside too, so could you check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that it is folded, fully enclosed, and you can carry it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 収納できています。車内では扉の付近を避け、ほかのお客様の通行を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is enclosed properly. On the train, avoid the door area and leave room for other passengers to pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。袋を持って移動し、置く場所にも気をつけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋で運び車内の通行を空けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will carry it in the bag and be careful where I put it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will carry it in the bag and keep the passage on the train clear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take care as you board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談会のお申し込みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying for the consultation session?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住宅の相談会に参加したいです。日本語で詳しく説明するのが難しいので、通訳を頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住宅相談会の通訳を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to attend the housing consultation. It is difficult for me to explain things in detail in Japanese. Could I request an interpreter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for an interpreter for the housing consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望の言語と相談の内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your preferred language and what you want to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。賃貸住宅の契約書で、分からない項目を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベトナム語と賃貸契約の相談を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnamese. I would like to ask about items I do not understand in my rental housing contract.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State Vietnamese and explain you want advice on a rental contract. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通訳の手配ができる日時を調べます。平日と土曜、どちらがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the dates and times when an interpreter can be arranged. Would a weekday or Saturday be better?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 仕事が休みの土曜を希望します。契約書も当日持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 土曜希望と契約書持参を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would prefer Saturday, when I am off work. I will also bring the contract that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you prefer Saturday and will bring the contract. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の土曜の十時なら手配できます。相談は三十分の枠です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can arrange one for ten o'clock next Saturday. The consultation slot is thirty minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その枠をお願いします。分からない三か所に付箋を付けて来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十時枠を選び三か所の付箋準備を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please book that slot. I will put sticky notes on the three parts I do not understand before coming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the ten o'clock slot and say you will mark three places with sticky notes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約票はこちらです。十時の少し前に受付へお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the reservation slip. Please come to reception a little before ten.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 土曜十時と三十分の枠を確認しました。予約票と契約書を持って受付へ来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時相談枠と持参物を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked Saturday at ten and the thirty-minute slot. I will bring the reservation slip and contract to reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the date, time, consultation length, and what to bring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約をお受けしました。当日お待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your reservation is accepted. We look forward to seeing you then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の前に、こちらの検査着へお着替えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before the examination, please change into this examination gown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上着だけ替えればよいですか。ズボンには金属のボタンがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 金属ボタン付きズボンの着替え範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Do I only need to change my top? My trousers have metal buttons.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how much to change when your trousers have metal buttons. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ズボンも替えてください。着替えはこの個室をお使いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please change your trousers too. You may use this private room to change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。アクセサリーと腕時計は、どこへ置けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 時計装身具の置き場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Where should I put my accessories and wristwatch?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where to put your watch and accessories. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小さい袋をお渡しします。袋はご自身のかばんへ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will give you a small bag. Please put the bag in your own larger bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋を使います。検査着のひもが後ろにあるので、結べなかったら手伝ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋利用と後ろひもの介助を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use it. The gown's ties are at the back. Could you help if I cannot tie them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will use the bag and ask for help with the back ties. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。着替えてから呼出しボタンでお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. After changing, please let us know with the call button.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 着替えました。後ろのひもだけ届かないので、お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着替え後にひもの介助を呼ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have changed. I cannot reach just the ties at the back, so please help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After changing, call for help with the ties. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 結びました。歩きにくい所はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have tied them. Is anything making it hard to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 裾も大丈夫です。時計を入れた袋はかばんにしまったので、このまま検査へ向かえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 裾と袋収納を確認し検査準備完了を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The hem is fine too. I have put the bag containing my watch in my own bag, so I am ready to go for the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the hem and storage of the bag and say you are ready for the examination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができましたね。検査室へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are ready now. I will guide you to the examination room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらへお出かけですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 向かいの建物へ行きたいです。この辺りに横断歩道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 向かいの建物へ渡れる横断歩道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to go to the building across the road. Is there a pedestrian crossing nearby?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a pedestrian crossing to get to the building opposite. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 右へ百メートルほど進むと、信号のある横断歩道があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: About a hundred meters to the right, there is a crossing with traffic lights.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 建物の正面にはないのですね。右へ進む時、交番の前の歩道を使えばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右へ向かう歩道を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So there is not one directly in front of the building. When going right, should I use the sidewalk in front of the police box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check which sidewalk to use when going right. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。同じ側の歩道で信号まで行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You can reach the traffic lights on the sidewalk on this same side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 信号を渡った後は、建物へ戻るように左へ進むのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 横断後の左への移動を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: After crossing at the lights, do I go left as if going back toward the building?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about going left after crossing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。建物の入口は角ではなく、道の中央寄りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is right. The building entrance is not on the corner but closer to the middle of the road.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右へ信号まで行き、渡って左ですね。入口の目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 行程を言い直し入口の目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Go right to the lights, cross, then left. Is there a landmark for the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the route and ask for a landmark at the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 青い庇の下が入口です。今いる所からも見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The entrance is under the blue awning. You can see it from here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青い庇が見えました。信号を回って、あの入口へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 青い庇を確認し信号経由で向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can see the blue awning. I will go around via the lights and head to that entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify the blue awning and say you will go via the lights. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけていってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切手をお探しでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人へのカード用に、花の切手を三枚買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 花柄切手三枚の購入を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to buy three flower stamps for cards to friends.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you would like to buy three flower-design stamps. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この花のシリーズは、一枚ずつお選びいただけます。額面は百十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can choose individual stamps from this flower series. The face value is 110 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カードは封筒に入れます。その額面で送れる重さか、先に量ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒の重さと額面適合を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will put the cards in envelopes. Could you weigh them first to see whether that value covers their weight?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the envelopes' weight and whether the stamp value is sufficient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封筒は三通とも同じ中身ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do all three envelopes have the same contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一通だけ写真も入っています。三通ともここに持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真入り一通を含む三通を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: One also contains a photograph. I have brought all three here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the three envelopes, including one with a photograph. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 量りました。三通とも百十円で送れます。柄はどれになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have weighed them. All three can be sent for 110 yen each. Which design would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: サクラを二枚、アジサイを一枚ください。写真入りにはアジサイを貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: サクラ二枚とアジサイ一枚を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two cherry blossoms and one hydrangea, please. I will put the hydrangea on the one with the photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose two cherry blossom stamps and one hydrangea stamp. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの三枚でお間違いありませんか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 柄と枚数が合っています。合計三百三十円を払って、記入台で貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 柄枚数合計を確認し支払い貼付へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The designs and quantity are right. I will pay the total of 330 yen and put them on at the writing counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the designs, quantity, and total, then say you will pay and attach the stamps. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。貼り終えたら窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. After attaching them, please come to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳を拝見してもよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。記帳したら最後のページがいっぱいになりました。新しい通帳に替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 満欄通帳の繰越しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. After updating it, the last page became full. I would like to replace it with a new passbook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a new passbook because the old one is full. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この通帳は繰越しできます。表紙のお名前も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can carry this passbook forward. Please also check the name on the cover.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の名前です。古い通帳に付けているカバーは、自分で外しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人名を確認しカバーを外す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is my name. I will remove the cover I have on the old passbook myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your own name and remove the cover. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。新しい通帳には続きの取引を記帳します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. We will record the subsequent transactions in the new passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今月の給料が入ったかも見たいので、未記帳の分までお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今月給料を含む未記帳分の記帳を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would also like to see whether this month's salary has arrived, so please include all the transactions not yet printed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to print unrecorded transactions, including this month's salary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 繰り越しました。こちらが古い通帳、新しい通帳には今月分が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: It has been carried forward. Here is the old passbook, and this month's entries are in the new one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 給料の入金がありました。古い通帳も持ち帰ってよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 給料入金を確認し旧通帳持帰りを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The salary deposit is there. I can take the old passbook home too, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the salary deposit and ask whether you can take the old passbook home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。古い通帳は使用済みですが、過去の記録として保管できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The old passbook is used up, but you can keep it as a record of past transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二冊を受け取りました。新しい方にカバーを付けて、今後の記帳に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二冊を受領し新通帳使用を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received both. I will put the cover on the new one and use it for future updates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you received both passbooks and will use the new one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for using our services.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕食を早く作りたいので、ゆで時間の短い乾麺を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ゆで時間の短い乾麺を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to make dinner quickly, so I am looking for dried noodles with a short boiling time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Look for dried noodles with a short boiling time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは三分、隣の商品は七分です。どちらも二人分が一袋です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: These take three minutes, and the product beside them takes seven. Each bag of either kind contains two servings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三分の方を見ます。鍋の水が沸いてから三分と読むので合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三分の計り始めを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will look at the three-minute ones. Is it correct to read this as three minutes after the water in the pot has boiled?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check when to start timing the three minutes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この表示では、沸騰した湯へ入れてからです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. This label means after putting them into boiling water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。つゆも用意したいのですが、これは薄めて使う物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: つゆの濃縮有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I would like to prepare the noodle sauce too. Is this one used diluted?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the noodle sauce is concentrated. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのつゆは二倍濃縮です。かける場合の割合は、裏に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: That sauce is double strength. The ratio for pouring it over noodles is written on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏の割合が見えました。麺一袋とこのつゆ一本を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示割合を読み麺とつゆを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see the ratio on the back. I will buy one bag of noodles and one bottle of this sauce.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the stated ratio and choose the noodles and sauce. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 麺の袋に破れはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is the noodle bag free of tears?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 破れもありません。ゆでる前に湯を沸かし、表示の時間で作ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋の状態を確認し調理手順を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: There are no tears either. I will bring the water to a boil before cooking the noodles and follow the time on the label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the bag's condition and explain the cooking steps. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞレジへお持ちください。お買物ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27226-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take them to the checkout. Thank you for shopping.
